## About
Auto Body Specialists is an independent body shop on S. Westwood in Mesa. We handle collision work, painting, frame and uni-body restoration, and glass replacement on all makes and models.
Repairs are done to the standards set by your vehicle manufacturer, and we use digital measuring and imaging systems for frame and uni-body work.
We work with insurance, fleet and personal customers. Neighbors have rated us 4.3 on Google from 30 reviews.

## Services
- Collision services: Body work after an accident for drivers around the greater Mesa area.
- Auto body repair and painting: Body work and paint for dents, damage and worn finishes.
- Frame and uni-body restoration: Frame and uni-body repairs using digital measuring and imaging systems.
- Glass replacement: Replacement of damaged auto glass.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Stop by our collision center on S. Westwood in Mesa and we'll look at your car and give you an estimate.

Q: Do you work on my make and model?
A: Yes. We work on all makes and all models.

Q: Do you handle insurance and fleet work?
A: Yes. We take on insurance, fleet and personal repairs.
